products.name: Wedding Seating Chart Maker
products.headline: Seat every guest with confidence.
products.sub: Build a venue-ready plan that tracks tables, households, meals, allergies, accessibility needs, children, and every unassigned guest.
features: Meal, allergy, accessibility, and child tracking
Venue, caterer, escort-card, and print exports
products.eyebrow: Venue-ready guest placement, without the spreadsheet chaos
products.promise: Turn your confirmed guest list into a complete table plan your venue and caterer can actually use.
audience: Coordinators who need a clean vendor handoff
outcomes: Every confirmed guest assigned or visibly unresolved
Meal, allergy and accessibility details attached to the right person
Alphabetical and table-order exports ready for vendors
objections: Can I use a free seating chart instead?
Yes, but most free tools stop at table placement. This product is built around reconciliation, meal and accessibility data, and vendor-ready exports.
What if my guest list changes?
You can revise the working files and regenerate the final handoff. The package includes a change-control checklist for late RSVPs and cancellations.
Does this replace my venue floor plan?
No. Use the venue-approved floor plan and capacity rules. This product organizes guests and handoff data; it does not certify occupancy or fire-code compliance.
